case: PostgreSQL enum drop/recreate with a warm client cache
initial_behavior: A previously prepared enum_range query failed after another session dropped and recreated its enum with XX000: cache lookup failed for type.
contract: Warm pooled query, controlled session query and execute statements before replacing a target enum while a same-named shadow enum leads search_path.
After recreation, verify the prepared query returns the new labels, qualified array metadata, distinct replacement scalar/array OIDs and PostgreSQL array_send bytes.
Clear cached statements and retry only the matching stale-type-cache error on non-transactional query and execute paths; transaction operations do not retry inside an aborted transaction.
